newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 50,000T tapioca tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 50,000T tapioca tenders.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) on Friday passed on tenders to buy 50,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet due to high offer prices, an official with the federation said.
The official said the federation also passed on tenders to buy 30,000 tonnes of wheat bran pellet or rice bran pellet for the same reason.
The federation will re-invite the tenders by 11:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday, he said.
Traders said the lowest bids of the passed tapioca pellet were made by Soon Hwa Seng at $91.00 a tonne C&F for five 10,000-tonne lots. Details for the others were unavailable.
